text:
Emma: Quick noon check — spinning up extra T4 prewarm in AMS1 for the demo traffic. Did the canary warm and started prewarm groups, ETA ~15m. @Raj
infra-bot: deploy started: prewarm-group-ams1 at 1729990005
Raj: saw the deploy, good call. Watch queue latency — if p99 > 350ms we should rollback early.
Emma: noted. p99 sits at ~180ms right now. Batching set to `max_batch_size:16`, `idle_timeout_ms:10`.
Sam: heads-up: provider quota for nvidia-a100 in EU is at 92%. I opened a ticket but we should migrate low-priority lanes to AMS2 spots to avoid impact.
Kelly: +1 migrate low-prio. Also enable fallback routing to `cpu-small` for background evals to keep them alive.
Emma: rolling low-priority lanes to AMS2 spots now. Running `./ops/move_lanes --region=ams2 --lane=low-prio`
Raj: quick note — scheduler didn't drain node-07 cleanly, saw `kubectl evict` timeout in logs. Sam, can you take a look?
Sam: on it. Looks like a stuck PVC unmount preventing pod eviction. I'll try a controlled force delete after confirming no active jobs.
Kelly: blocker for me — can we temporarily increase reserved buffer for AMS1 from 8 -> 12 until the quota clears? Need extra headroom for the customer demo. :eyes:
Emma: I can bump ephemeral buffer now. Updating `fleet.buffers.ams1=12` and deploying.
infra-bot: config apply success for fleet.buffers.ams1=12 at 1729990180
Raj: thanks. Small ask — add a smoke prompt set to the canary after migration to validate generation quality (latency + smoke quality).
Emma: added smoke eval `smoke/latency+quality-ams1` and kicked it off. First pass looks fine, no obvious regressions.
Kelly: timeline on the cloud ticket?
Sam: ticket CLD-2938 opened, provider ETA 6-12h. I asked for expedited review and included our account rep.
Emma: plan for today: finish migration of low-prio lanes to AMS2, monitor p99 and error rates, revert buffer to 8 when quotas permit. Blocker: waiting on provider window or approval to migrate some customer-testing lanes.
Raj: LGTM. If p99 exceeds 400ms in the next 30m I'll start failover to the EU fallback pool.
Kelly: thanks — ping me when background jobs are fully on AMS2. :thumbsup:
